correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs every quantifier and boundary for \(m\ge3\). A four-term unit cancellation yields an antipodal perfect matching; the dyadic congruence \(kx\equiv2^{m-1}\pmod{2^m}\) is solved exactly by one frequency valuation shell; the normalized parity split gives all and only the stated balanced-level patterns. Explicit witnesses realize every admissible pattern. Exact cyclotomic computation through \(N=32\) corroborates, but is not used to infer, the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification on the first support size where multiple antipodal pairings can interact. It determines the full Fourier zero geometry, not just an uncertainty bound, for every dyadic cyclic order and gives sharp witness families for every admissible pattern. The result is structurally reusable for sparse coefficient-one masks and is not a mere recomputation of a finite table.
